response.what_it_is: One-head industrial monogram embroidery machine with large extension table
hidden_risks: Working condition of the computerized control panel and motherboard
Alignment and smooth movement of the large pantograph frame
Incompleteness of required embroidery hoops and accessories
response.best_proof: A video showing the control screen powered on and executing a test embroidery run
response.failure_mode: Confusing the specialized large-area embroidery machine and table setup for general office furniture or a basic sewing machine.
